messages.subject: Help Needed: looking for DISTANCE programmer
parts:
Dear DISTANCE Listers
I am in need of help. I am unfamiliar with DISTANCE and do not have time to learn the program before presenting a paper =
in January. Please let me know if there is anyone who would be wiling to process bird count data for a project estimatin=
g the impact of Phragmites australis on bird populations in coastal Massachusetts, USA. I have data for bird detections =
in 4 adjoining habitats, and I have good estimates of the distance from the observer (myself) to the bird. In several ca=
ses more than one habitat was present in a given study site and often there was more than one habitat between the observe=
r and the bird. I expect that detection probabilities of the different habitats are very different. Is this an appropri=
ate situation for using DISTANCE?
Please excuse me for not taking the time to research this myself, but I do not currently feel that I have the time. I kn=
ow that this is a situation many share, but if anyone knows the answer and if anyone is intrested in the job please let m=
e know.
Thank you,
Eric Holt
e-mail: nfi...@massed.net
